answer: Yes, but you'll need to do two things first. Our North Carolina stores buy cars registered in any state we serve, but a car registered in another state needs an emissions certificate from a North Carolina inspection station before we can buy it there. In most states we can buy a car with an expired registration, but North Carolina is the exception: the registration has to be current on the day of the sale. So renew your Virginia registration before your appointment, and bring the registration Virginia issued. Your plates follow the state that issued them, so take off your Virginia plates and keep them.
